title: „Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" – Verkehrssicherheits-Aktionstag zum Schulanfang in der STATION Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Road safety action day "Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" for second-graders was held at STATION Berlin near Park am Gleisdreieck. Officials urged drivers to take care around schoolchildren at the start of the school year.
